The sound played for incoming voice and video calls

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Dark mode
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Off: follow your device theme. On: override it with the opposite theme

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: App lock
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Ask for your fingerprint or device PIN when Bluechat opens or returns from the background

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Turn on Bluetooth automatically
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: Let Bluechat switch Bluetooth on when it starts

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Turn off Bluetooth on exit
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: Let Bluechat switch Bluetooth off when you exit

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Only if Bluechat turned it on
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: Only switch Bluetooth off if Bluechat was the one that turned it on

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Listen for incoming connections
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: If off, you will be offline when the app starts. Tap the eye icon in the toolbar to go active.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Multiple connections
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Connect to several devices, or let several devices connect to you.\nNot recommended: it can slow the app down and use more battery.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Maximum connections
EditTextPreference.app:summary: How many devices can be connected at the same time

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Disconnect others during calls
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Disconnect all other devices while you are on a voice or video call.\nRecommended: Bluetooth calling uses a lot of bandwidth.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Don't scan while connected
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Scanning uses a lot of power. When on, Bluechat will not scan for devices while you are connected to one.

CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Hide alerts
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: Never show alert dialogs.\nNot recommended: alerts tell you about important things.

Preference.app:title: Blocked devices
Preference.app:summary: See and manage the devices you have blocked
